gloss: hazard management; danger management; safety management

definitions.gloss: hazard management; danger management; safety management
definitions.explanation: The systematic identification and control of dangers and hazards, particularly in workplaces, industrial settings, and daily life. Focuses on preventing accidents and injuries.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}での{危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}を{徹底|てってい}する。
examples.english: We will thoroughly implement hazard management in the factory.

examples.japanese: {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}{意識|いしき}が{低|ひく}いと{事故|じこ}につながる。
examples.english: Low awareness of hazard management leads to accidents.

examples.japanese: {登山|とざん}では{天候|てんこう}の{変化|へんか}に{対|たい}する{危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}が{命|いのち}を{守|まも}る。
examples.english: In mountain climbing, hazard management regarding weather changes protects lives.

notes:
A compound of {危険|きけん} (danger; hazard) and {管理|かんり} (management; control). Distinguished from {危機|きき}{管理|かんり} (crisis management, reactive) and リスク{管理|かんり} (risk management, probabilistic), {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり} emphasizes proactive identification and prevention of concrete dangers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}{体制|たいせい}: hazard management system
- {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}{意識|いしき}: safety awareness
- {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}マニュアル: hazard management manual
- {危険|きけん}{管理|かんり}{教育|きょういく}: safety management training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {危機|きき}{管理|かんり}: crisis management — dealing with crises after they occur
- リスク{管理|かんり}: risk management — assessing and mitigating probabilistic risks
- {安全|あんぜん}{管理|かんり}: safety management — broader term for ensuring safety in general
